description: Frontend data layer and topic-first flow. Hook copy, new /topic route and chip list, 7 topics with takeaways and related-topic top-up mirrored from the backend, table-driven approved.ts importing both JSON banks, TOPIC_SELECTED analytics, steerDestination strips query/hash, user-initiated offline fallback, and repairs of existing tests/e2e/verify-playable broken by the intentional copy/flow changes. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports glp1-topic-bank-v9.json). Independent of FEAT-003 UI work except shared test helpers.
steps: Read plan.md sections 2, 3 and FEAT-002; read src/types.ts, src/data/topics.ts, src/data/approved.ts, src/services/{quiz,api,analytics,config}.ts, src/pages/{Landing,Play,Results,Explore}.tsx, src/components/{TopicPicker,DoctorChecklist}.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/styles/learning.css and the existing tests.
src/types.ts: add DIABETES to LearningTopic; add checked?: Record<string, boolean> to QuizDraft.

src/data/topics.ts: 7 topics in order SAFETY, SIDE_EFFECTS, MUSCLE, MAINTENANCE, DIABETES, ELIGIBILITY, GENERAL with the exact labels from plan.md D2, a doctor `question` for each (DoctorChecklist uses it), `takeaway` text from plan.md section 3, export relatedTopics (same map as backend) and contentReview = { reviewedBy: null as string | null }.

src/data/approved.ts: refactor to a uniform table (legacy 1-9 from existing code, V8 bank, V9 bank) keeping exports disclaimer, questions (first 3 legacy), questionPool (active only), questionTopics, selectQuestions, scoreLocal; add answerKey covering retired ids and export revealAnswer(questionId, optionId). Apply reassign/retitle/retire from the V9 JSON. selectQuestions mirrors the backend (on-topic first, related top-up, GENERAL one-per-concern). Update scoreLocal nextStep copy.

src/services/analytics.ts: add TOPIC_SELECTED:['topic'] and CTA_CLICKED:['destination','ctaContext']. src/services/config.ts: steerDestination returns origin+pathname only; honour storage flag 'offline-fallback' by making mode 'standalone'.

src/services/quiz.ts: add chooseTopic(topic) (resetQuiz, store 'learning-topic', track TOPIC_SELECTED with only {topic}, no sessionId) and useOfflineEdition(); Play.tsx error panel gets a 'Play the offline edition instead' button that sets the flag and reloads (never silent).

Create src/pages/Topic.tsx and rework src/components/TopicPicker.tsx: h1 'What makes you unsure about GLP-1?', sub-line, 7 button chips (>=44px, 320px safe), 'Skip, surprise me' link, resume panel ('Continue your quiz' / 'Start over') when a matching draft exists. Add lazy /topic route in src/App.tsx; point header 'Take the quiz', EmptyState link, Results 'Play again' and Explore 'Choose another topic' to /topic.

src/pages/Landing.tsx: hook copy from plan.md section 3 (h1 'GLP-1: how much is fact, and how much is fear?', primary link 'Bust the myths in 60 seconds' to /topic, teaser chips, reassurance line); remove TopicPicker from the hero; keep the CTA fully above y=600 at 390x740 by tuning the h1 clamp() size. Add CSS in src/styles/learning.css (topic buttons, teaser chips, visible focus); drop obsolete .topic-picker chip rules.

Repair existing tests only: src/test/question-pool.test.ts (active pool count 37; id-based selection in the 'scores only the selected questions' test), src/test/app.test.tsx (hook heading, CTA name, topic buttons on /topic, analytics-consent navigation), e2e/flows.spec.ts (hook CTA + 'Skip, surprise me', resume path, CTA-above-600 assertion), scripts/verify-playable.mjs (7 topic labels, new CTA names). Do not add new tests.
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc -b, npm run lint, npx vitest run and npm run build all succeed in /Users/milendrakumarbaghel/Documents/Hackathon/metaboquest/problem1/frontend
Landing shows the new hook and one primary CTA 'Bust the myths in 60 seconds' above y=600 at 390x740 and no horizontal overflow at 320px
/topic offers the 7 labelled options plus 'Skip, surprise me'; tapping a topic starts a quiz whose 3 questions all belong to that topic (offline selectQuestions); connected mode posts {topic} only
TOPIC_SELECTED is sent only with analytics consent and carries only {topic}
verification: cd /Users/milendrakumarbaghel/Documents/Hackathon/metaboquest/problem1/frontend && npx tsc -b && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build
grep-based banned-string scan over src (non-test) from context.json returns nothing outside href/url values
findings:
DONE (uncommitted). Checks: npx tsc -b, npm run lint, npx vitest run (36 pass), npm run build all OK; banned-string scan over src (non-test) clean; npm run test:playable PASS for all 7 topics offline (zero network requests); npm run test:e2e: 3 of 4 pass (incl. CTA above y=600 at 320-430 widths and no overflow incl. new /topic at 320-1440). KNOWN E2E FAILURE (not caused by this FEAT, unresolved): 'mobile connected flow, ... dialog focus' fails deterministically at the 12x Tab loop in the share dialog right after the PNG download (document.activeElement becomes BODY after the download in this Chrome; ShareSheet/Dialog code untouched here). FEAT-003 should check/stabilise it (e.g. re-focus the dialog before the Tab loop) when it edits the same test.

FILES: types.ts (DIABETES, QuizDraft.checked); data/topics.ts (7 topics in D2 order, label/question/takeaway, relatedTopics, contentReview={reviewedBy:null}); data/approved.ts (table-driven entries from legacy 1-9 + V8 bank + V9 bank; retitle/reassign/retire from V9 JSON applied; exports disclaimer, questions, questionPool (37 active), questionTopics (all ids), selectQuestions, scoreLocal, NEW revealAnswer(questionId, optionId)->{correct,correctOptionId,explanation,sources}|undefined; answerKey covers retired ids; V9 multi-source questions give all sources); services/analytics.ts (TOPIC_SELECTED:['topic'], CTA_CLICKED:['destination','ctaContext']); services/config.ts (offline-fallback storage flag -> mode standalone; steerDestination returns origin+pathname only, '/' root stays 'https://steerclub.com'); services/quiz.ts (chooseTopic(topic), switchToOfflineEdition()); pages/Topic.tsx (new, lazy /topic route, resume panel, h1 focused via queueMicrotask); components/TopicPicker.tsx (button chips -> chooseTopic + navigate('/play'); 'Skip, surprise me' is a <Link to=/play> so role=link); pages/Landing.tsx (new hook, class hook-title, teaser chips ul.teaser-chips, CTA link 'Bust the myths in 60 seconds' -> /topic); App.tsx (/topic route, nav 'Take the quiz' -> /topic); ui.tsx EmptyState, Results 'Play again', Explore 'Choose another topic' -> /topic; Play.tsx error panel 'Play the offline edition instead' (connected mode only, reloads); styles/learning.css (topic/teaser/resume styles, hook h1 size, removed .topic-picker chip rules).

DEVIATIONS / NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: (1) plan's useOfflineEdition() was named switchToOfflineEdition() because eslint react-hooks flags 'use*' calls inside handlers. (2) App.tsx privacy dialog still says 'No chosen topic is included in these events' which is now inaccurate when consent is on; FEAT-003 step 6 must replace it with the plan section 3 copy. (3) Explore.tsx hero CTA still 'See if Steer fits you' and Results still has 'Explore Steer' link: FEAT-003 owns SteerHandoff. (4) Tests repaired: question-pool.test.ts (37 active, reverse-pool selection using revealAnswer), app.test.tsx (hook heading, 'Bust the myths' link, 'What about side effects?' button, 'Skip, surprise me' link via findBy since /topic is lazy), e2e/flows.spec.ts (startFromHook helper, resume via 'Continue your quiz', /topic overflow check in the width loop), scripts/verify-playable.mjs (7 labels, buttons on /topic, 'all seven'). Topic buttons are role=button with accessible name equal to the label (arrow is aria-hidden). (5) Initial JS bundle: index chunk 276.8 kB (gzip 88.6 kB); approved chunk (29 kB) is still dynamic-imported only from quiz.ts; Landing/TopicPicker import only topics.ts. (6) Hook CTA measured above y=600 at 320/375/390/430 x 740 with chips placed before the CTA, so no layout reorder was needed.
